note: The OAK-1 with the 1 MP global-shutter colour OV9782 instead of the IMX378 (docs page variant "Fixed Focus OV9782"): 89.5 (D) / 80 (H) / 55 (V) degrees, fixed focus. The lens model is pinhole, a labelled ASSUMPTION: the maker states no projection or distortion coefficients; calibrate a unit and store its K and D in the sensor calibration. Streams are the sensor modes the RVC2 driver supports, each with its maximum frame rate only (Luxonis sensor page); the format on the USB link depends on the on-device pipeline (raw, NV12 or encoded), so format and bits_per_pixel are null. Body figures are the OAK-1's (the datasheet and store page do not single out this variant): power_w the datasheet maximum 7.5 W, size [27.88, 35, 54.5] mm from the datasheet (W x H x D 35 x 54.5 x 27.88), mass 53 g (store page). Not stated: f-number, distortion.
